newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey sells 34.6 trln lira of 2-year bonds.
newsitem.headline: Turkey sells 34.6 trln lira of 2-year bonds.

text.p: Turkey sold 34.6 trillion lira of two-year inflation-indexed bonds at 25 percent risk premium on Tuesday, compared to 10 trillion lira sale and 22 percent risk premium in the previous two-year bond auction on May 1.
There will be three-month coupon payments on the bonds.
Banks will pay 34.3 trillion lira to the Treasury for the auction on Wednesday when the treasury will repay 130 trillion lira of bond maturities.
State minister Ufuk Soylemez said the Treasury would continue to hold two-year inflation-indexed bond auctions in May.
